name: The Proving Grounds Superstar of the Week
epitaph: A weekly line on the parent company's own front page, one for each of its brands, giving the farm league's pick of the week and the reason in a single sentence. Two of them survive, three weeks apart in the spring of 2005; both name a man beating somebody the front page thought worth naming.

bestowals.source: PWE's own front page as the board rendered it on 13 April 2005 (held in the workshop, not served)
bestowals.vote_detail: “The Proving Grounds Superstar of the week: Wil The Thrill — Wil was able to retain his TPG International Championship in a main event match with Carlito Caribbean Cool!”

bestowals.source: PWE's own front-page news of 1 May 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/front-page-news-2005-05-01.html)
bestowals.vote_detail: “The Proving Grounds Superstar of the week: Chris Leben — Chris Leben was able to make the former PWE World Champ, Kurt Angle, tap out in a submission match!”

notes: The parent company ran the same honour for its other two brands in the same panel; only the farm league's own two citations are registered here.
